name: session-tts
description: Read Claude Code responses aloud locally with a different Japanese voice per session. Instructs Claude to deliver mid-turn progress narration via a synchronous Bash call into the say adapter, plus a TodoWrite hook that nudges narration at task transitions. Permission prompts include the workspace name. ON by default; playback volume is adjustable via /session-tts:volume. Engine and models are managed automatically. Apple Silicon only.
